  "strategy": "Attempt 2: swap the family from hist_gbdt to xgboost — a different boosting implementation with row<path> subsampling and per-node regularisation the previous attempt did not have — to lift the ranking axis (roc_auc / balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut), since cut_headroom was only 0.0116 and even the best cut of attempt 1's ranking (0.8702) falls short of the 0.8811 bar.   "rationale": "The bar 0.8811 is above attempt 1's balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut of 0.8702, so no reweighting or cut of that model's ranking can reach it — the remaining distance is on the ranking axis (implied KS 0.7404 vs required 0.7622), and cut_headroom of 0.0116 confirms the operating point is nearly spent. The lever with recorded movement on the ranking axis is swapping families under an unchanged pipeline, so this attempt does exactly that, and xgboost adds two regularisers hist_gbdt lacked here (row and column subsampling) which decorrelate the boosted trees — relevant because train_balanced_accuracy 0.9371 vs val 0.8586 (gap 0.0786) says raw capacity at the old learning rate mostly buys gap, not ranking. The slower learning rate with far more rounds and depth-8 depth-wise growth explores a different bias<path> point than 400×0.06 leaf-wise trees, while reg_lambda=2.0<path>=0.5 and min_child_weight=2 keep the extra depth from being spent on the 11.7% minority tail. scale_pos_weight=7.5 ≈ the 7.55 imbalance ratio reproduces the near-parity recall<path> of attempt 1 (0.8365 / 0.8806), so balanced_accuracy will track the ranking improvement rather than being confounded by a moved cut. Cost is safe: attempt 1 trained in 9 s of 600 s, and 1200 shallow-ish trees on 27k rows × 51 encoded columns stays well inside both the time and 2048 MB budgets. Preprocessing is held fixed because the card reports 0% true missingness — the 'unknown' markers in V2<path> are already one-hot levels the trees can split on, so missing_indicator<path> would add nothing (and V16's 81.8% 'unknown' means any column built from it is near-constant), and impute='none' with a NaN-splitting family makes indicators provably redundant.",
